title: Observability for streaming responses: per-chunk metrics, tracing spans, and redaction
creator: Maya Hernandez
description: Goal: Add first-class observability for streamed API responses. Deliver per-chunk metrics (latency, token count/size, status), explicit tracing spans for each chunk and tool/function-call boundary, and safe log redaction/sampling for streamed payloads. This ticket covers design, runtime instrumentation, gateway changes, metric aggregation rules, and a compatibility mode for older SDKs that cannot surface chunk-level telemetry. The work should preserve current latency SLOs and not increase per-request tail latency beyond 1ms on p95 in the gateway path.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway emits a unique chunk_id for every stream chunk and attaches it to traces and metrics
Per-chunk metrics available in Prometheus/metrics pipeline: chunk_latency_ms, chunk_tokens, chunk_bytes, chunk_status (ok|error|tool_call)
Tracing: spans created for chunk emission, tool/function call invocation, and gateway backpressure. Spans include model, route, customer_id (hashed), and chunk_sequence
Log redaction applied to any debug/stream payloads sent to central logging; redaction rules follow PII policy and are configurable per-customer
Compatibility mode: when client SDKs don't support chunk-level annotations, server emits aggregated per-request metrics and an opt-in header to request chunk telemetry
E2E tests validate chunk ordering, loss/retry cases, and that redaction removes email/SSN-like tokens from logs
Documentation updated: Console doc for per-chunk observability, SDK changelog with compatibility details, and runbook for investigating stream regressions
comments: 2025-11-04 Maya Hernandez: Initial writeup and scope. Focus on three pillars: metrics, tracing, redaction. Flagging ENG-4702 (gateway framing changes) as a blocker until chunk_id is added.

2025-11-06 Ethan Cole: Design review notes - prefer lightweight integer chunk_sequence plus a UUID session_id to keep per-span tags small. Suggest using histogram buckets for chunk_latency_ms: [0.5,1,2,5,10,50,200] ms.

2025-11-07 Priya Rao (SRE): Concern about cardinality from customer_id tag. Recommend hashed_customer_id and a sampling knob for chunk-level metrics. Also recommend rollup metrics (request_level_chunk_count) to limit cardinality.

2025-11-08 Ethan Cole: Prototype implemented in gateway branch feat/stream-chunk-tracing. Added chunk_id header X-RW-Chunk-Id and chunk-seq in SSE events. Local perf microbench shows +0.3ms p95 on small payloads.

2025-11-09 Clara Nguyen (Security): Redaction policy draft uploaded to Confluence: /confluence/security/streaming-redaction. We will redact patterns for emails, credit-card-like numbers, SSNs, and API keys. Redaction is deterministic and reversible only in customer-controlled logs (Private deployments). Central logs will be irreversible redaction.
2025-11-10 QA: Added tests for dropped-chunk and reconnect behavior; found a race where chunk_sequence could reset on reconnect. Created ENG-4850 to track reconnect sequence persistence fix.
2025-11-11 Docs (Samir Patel): Drafted Console doc and SDK changelog. Need final API header naming confirmed before publishing. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-gateway/pull/2143

2025-11-12 Ethan Cole: Started implementation of span attribution for tool calls. Using OpenTelemetry semantic conventions; span names: rw.stream.chunk.emit, rw.stream.tool.call. Next step: wire spans into tracing backend and add chunk_sequence as span attribute 'rw.chunk.seq'.
